statement: Design the machine-checkable completeness/replay certificate architecture needed to certify that every one of the 178 open numerical rows is covered by the eventual compressed enumerator, independently of which pruning route wins.

scope.quantifiers: every required even degree/genus row and every exact symmetry/intersection stratum used by production
scope.required_output: coverage manifest schema, replay verifier contract, duplicate/orbit accounting invariants, and fail-closed missing-stratum checks

queries: bounded Stage32 residual-32-01-production tree inspection for FULL178 manifest/checkpoint/verifier assets
FULL178 manifest checkpoint replay coverage receiver183
matches: full178-manifest.json: authoritative 178-row / 64111-stratum domain and canonical SHA-256 contract
full178-production-preflight.json: disjoint-work-unit, zero-unknown, resource-ceiling, and evidence policy contract
verify_full178_preflight.py: audited-source reconstruction and canonical JSON hash convention
run_full178_resumable_work_unit.py: deterministic self-hashed work-unit/cursor/segment-chain evidence with explicit unknown_count
full178-prefix-indexed-compression-main-checkpoint.json: exact indexed terminal family and canonical order, but numerical Picard leaf checks incomplete

attempts.core_contract: derive exactly 178 rows and 64111 (row_id,e) strata from locked manifest; normalize every producer into disjoint half-open canonical indexed-terminal rank blocks; require exact gap-free union, zero unknown, registered exact dispositions, and deterministic replay hashes

retained_result.authoritative_outer_domain: 178 residual rows / 64111 exact (row_id,e) coarse strata reconstructed from full178-manifest.json
retained_result.route_independent_inner_domain: half-open canonical indexed-terminal rank intervals [rank_lo,rank_hi) per (row_id,e)
retained_result.completion_rule: all expected strata present exactly once at aggregate level; every canonical terminal rank covered exactly once by a registered exact disposition; no gaps, overlaps, extras, hash/replay mismatch, or unknowns
retained_result.critical_firewall: prefix/indexed-family completion is not numerical-row completion

notes: Do not assume a successful shard implies global row coverage.
Keep certificate independent enough to check whichever compression route becomes load-bearing.
The indexed-compression checkpoint still records numerical_picard_leaf_checks_complete=false; N104 grants no FULL178 numerical completeness credit.
A producer that cannot map its claimed subset bijectively into the locked canonical indexed-terminal rank domain receives no aggregate completeness credit.
